create_inference_server: create an InferenceServer subclass that implements start_server and monitor_health for a custom inference backend
run_server_with_context_manager: run an InferenceServer as an async context manager to auto-start, monitor, and clean up the server process
test_server_health: test the InferenceServer.is_ready method to check if the server responds on /v1/models with a 200 status
make_inference_request: make an inference request via InferenceServer.make_request with a payload dict to /v1/chat/completions or /v1/completions
find_available_port: find an available TCP port using _find_available_port with a rank offset and port scan fallback
